value.rationale: The central benefit of stabilized stochastic RKC methods is increased allowed outer learning rate. This theorem gives a sharp, non-routine stage-extremum obstruction to interpreting scalar deterministic stability as mean-square stochastic stability, exhibits strict opposite behavior between random sampled and full-gradient schemes, and quantifies sensitivity by an exact quadratic variance pole. A natural positive-damping remedy is already used by the method authors. Scope is carefully limited to undamped fixed-step sampled quadratics, so no unsupported claim about their recommended decreasing/damped schemes.
